# YouTube Shorts Scraper

The Apify actor [`streamers/youtube-shorts-scraper`](https://apify.com/streamers/youtube-shorts-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.261**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract YouTube Shorts data from one or multiple YouTube channels. Get video URL, caption, timestamp, likes, dislikes, views and comments count, basic channel info, and more. This alternative YouTube API has no limits or quotas. Download the data in JSON, CSV, and Excel.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Short $0.004, Date filter $0.0013 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/streamers/youtube-shorts-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/streamers-youtube-shorts-scraper@0.0.261#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      channels: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `channels` | array | yes |  | Name(s) of the channel — Enter a username of a channel (without @ sign) or a link to it (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/c/Apify). |
| `maxResultsShorts` | integer |  | `1` | Maximum number of shorts per search term — Limit the number of Shorts videos you want to crawl from the channel. |
| `oldestPostDate` | string \| null |  |  | Scrape shorts published after [date] — Only posts uploaded after or on this date will be scraped. Alternatively, specify how old the scraped videos should be in days. Putting 1 day will get you only today's posts, 2 days - yesterday's and today's, and so on.
